title: zazzle invoker deployment diagram
description: What `make` produces and where it runs: one small executable per platform, run once per command in the user's shell; the only zazzle command on PATH (also as `z`), it starts the daemon and hands every other tool its command from the tools' folder, libexec/zazzle beside its own bin/. `zazzle zazz install` links installed script commands to it; it tells them apart by the name it was started under. The daemon side is in src/macos/daemon/.dev/deployment-diagram.json; the release ships build/zazzle as bin/zazzle (with bin/z) in the macOS and Linux tarballs, with the tools in libexec/zazzle.

sources.symbol: Build and smoke test the zazzle invoker

nodes.name: Mac
nodes.description: Apple silicon (arm64) only; Intel Macs have no zazzle.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle CMD ...` or `zazz CMD ...`, with ZAZZLE_SESSION set for ids and dedupe.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs a zazz script installed as a command: ~/.zazzle/bin/NAME, a symlink to the invoker.

nodes.name: zazzle process (Linux)
nodes.description: A static executable with no libc: raw syscalls only, its own `_start`.

nodes.name: zazzle process (macOS)
nodes.description: Loaded by dyld with libSystem, entered at `main`; its I/O, socket and exec calls are still raw syscalls.

nodes.name: zazzle daemon serve process
nodes.description: The daemon; see the daemon deployment diagram.

nodes.name: Program the invoker becomes
nodes.description: For `zazzle run`, `zazzle proxy`, `zazzle setup`, `zazzle agent llm|prompt`, `zazzle ai-agent`, `zazzle git` and `zazzle TOOL` for each tool, the same process after exec: `daemon wrap`, `daemon proxy`, `daemon setup`, `daemon llm` (which in turn execs ai-agent, downloaded on first use: src/macos/ai-agent/.dev/deployment-diagram.json), or the tool found in the tools' folder (git-tools for `git`), with the caller's environment, streams and exit status.

artifacts.name: build/zazzle (Linux)
artifacts.description: -Os -ffreestanding, linked -static -nostdlib -no-pie with sections garbage-collected, two LOAD segments (-z noseparate-code) and symbols stripped; shipped in the Linux release tarballs as bin/zazzle, with bin/z linked to it.

artifacts.name: build/zazzle (macOS)
artifacts.description: -Os -ffreestanding with ZAZZLE_LIBSYSTEM, linked against libSystem with dead code stripped; shipped in the macOS release tarball and the Homebrew bottle as bin/zazzle; the tarball also links bin/z to it, Homebrew links z only when nothing else uses it.
